name: Langry RH75-A Brick & Lightweight Concrete Hammer
short_description: Low impact energy (0.735 J) hammer for testing solid clay bricks, lightweight aggregate concrete, AAC blocks, and thin structural components.
description: The **Langry RH75-A Test Hammer** (Type L) features a reduced impact energy of 0.735 Joules specifically calibrated for solid clay bricks, AAC lightweight blocks, and mortar joints without shattering delicate masonry surfaces.
